content: Adults with type 1 diabetes should receive comprehensive education on how to adjust their insulin doses to match their carbohydrate intake accurately. This education is essential for optimizing glycemic control and minimizing the risk of hypoglycemia. In addition to carbohydrate intake, other factors must be taken into account when determining insulin doses. These factors include the amount of fat and protein in the meal, current blood glucose levels, anticipated physical activity, and the presence of any illness.
